Watford are 21st after four wins in 16 matches, while 13th-placed Blackburn have won six. The hosts are trying to respond to a heavy defeat; the visitors arrive after a draw in which they twice came from behind. Watford will want a more secure start after conceding four to Sheffield United, while Blackburn have shown in their latest game that falling behind need not end their chances. An early goal is a plausible direction for this match, even if the teams' [...] The recent head-to-head record offers little separation.
